t: Save Money, Shop Bulk: A Guide to Rice – Choose Homemade
s: March 28, 2025 - When you buy rice in smaller portions, companies have to spend more on packaging and advertising, which increases the cost of each package. However, if you buy rice in bulk, you can avoid these additional expenses and get a better price per pound. While the upfront cost of bulk rice may seem higher, the long-term savings become clear over time.
